column3: The log journal source is now produced (W5a P-log, SharpitLogHandler): one event per WARN-or-above record with BootUI LogPayload fields (logger, level, template, exceptionClass); the kind itself is not implemented; deviations: records below WARNING are not offered (BootUI RuntimeJournalLogAppender records WARN and above only); WARNING is level WARN and CRITICAL is ERROR; template is LogRecord.msg unformatted, masked and cut at 500 (an object gives its class name, never its str()); envelope executionId and threadKind absent; marks not carried; exceptionClass from exc_info (the exception's class when set); requestId only for this install's requests; sharpit's own loggers and internal work are skipped (BootUI skips its own loggers); produced whenever the journal lists `log`, with or without the log-tail and exceptions panels (the handler is installed for the journal alone, as BootUI installs RuntimeJournalLogAppender whenever records(LOG); with `log` not a listed source and both panels off, no handler is installed); exceptionClass is the class name without the `builtins.` prefix, as P-exception writes it (BootUI writes the fully qualified Java name); the template is LogRecord.msg, so an f-string or a concatenated str(exc) IS the template: shown masked at MASKED, unmasked at FULL, withheld (null) at METADATA_ONLY, the same limit as BootUI LogPayload (an argument never enters); it is masked as the log tail's message is, so a secret-looking word in a template can mask what follows it; masking reads the first 500 characters plus a 4096-character margin, then the template is cut at 500; a masked template is cached (256, only for a record with arguments)
The log journal source (level, requestId) is now produced; the kind itself is not implemented
